import heapq
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    H = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    W = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    X = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    P = int(data[idx]) - 1; idx += 1
    Q = int(data[idx]) - 1; idx += 1
    S = []
    for i in range(H):
        row = [int(data[idx + j]) for j in range(W)]
        idx += W
        S.append(row)
    T = S[P][Q]
    visited = [[False] * W for _ in range(H)]
    visited[P][Q] = True
    heap = []
    dirs = [(1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)]

    def push_neighbors(i, j):
        for di, dj in dirs:
            ni, nj = i + di, j + dj
            if 0 <= ni < H and 0 <= nj < W and not visited[ni][nj]:
                visited[ni][nj] = True
                heapq.heappush(heap, (S[ni][nj], ni, nj))

    push_neighbors(P, Q)
    while heap:
        s, i, j = heap[0]
        if X * s < T:
            heapq.heappop(heap)
            T += s
            push_neighbors(i, j)
        else:
            break
    print(T)
